title: Root documentation relocations
description:
Relocate root `TESTING.md` to contributor documentation and settle `INSTALL.md`'s home, so the repository root carries only conventional adopter-facing files and every inbound link resolves to the final locations.

## Background

Two owner decisions drive this work. First, root `TESTING.md` is contributor documentation — its content (this repository's three-layer test strategy, test-harness usage, source layout) addresses contributors, not adopters — so it belongs under `dev/`, the contributor-documentation home. Second, the owner's durable preference is a lean repository root: conventional files (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) stay at root, contributor content lives under `dev/`, and adopter content lives under `docs/`. That preference makes `INSTALL.md` (351 lines, adopter-facing) a relocation candidate for `docs/`, evaluated under the deletion/merge policy: a move happens only if it is a clean win, and the verdict is recorded either way — link topology or packaging-doc conventions may argue for keeping it at root.

**Relocation 1 — TESTING.md (mandatory).** Root `TESTING.md` moves to `dev/TESTING.md`. Its three live inbound links are repointed in the same change: `CLAUDE.md:124`, `dev/index.md:145`, `dev/architecture/core-system-design.md:402`. Historical records under `dev/archive/` and `dev/studies/` are records of past state and keep their original `TESTING.md` mentions unrepointed. `web/TESTING.md` is a distinct file and is unaffected.

**Relocation 2 — INSTALL.md (evaluate, then execute only if clean).** Evaluate relocating `INSTALL.md`'s content into `docs/` (a how-to/tutorial home). Execute only if it is a clean win: every inbound link repointed tree-wide (three live: `README.md:58`, `docs/how-to/deployment.md:172`, `docs/tutorials/quickstart.md:76`) and a short install pointer remaining in `README.md`. If declined, `INSTALL.md` stays at root and the declining rationale is recorded.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `TESTING.md` exists at `dev/TESTING.md` and not at the repository root; the three live inbound links (`CLAUDE.md:124`, `dev/index.md:145`, `dev/architecture/core-system-design.md:402`) resolve to the new path; and no adopter-facing doc or root file references the old root location (historical records under `dev/archive/` and `dev/studies/` keep their original mentions; `web/TESTING.md` is a distinct, unaffected file).
- [hard] REQ-02: An evaluation verdict on relocating `INSTALL.md`'s content into `docs/` is recorded with rationale; if executed, the content lives under `docs/`, every inbound link (`README.md:58`, `docs/how-to/deployment.md:172`, `docs/tutorials/quickstart.md:76`) resolves to the new home, and `README.md` carries a short install pointer; if declined, `INSTALL.md` remains at root with the declining rationale recorded.

## Notes

- Touching the `dev/` files and the `CLAUDE.md` link line is an owner-sanctioned exception to the surrounding audit's non-goal of leaving `dev/` and `CLAUDE.md` untouched, scoped to these relocations only.
- Both relocations follow repoint-before-remove discipline: no file moves before its inbound links are repointed in the same change, and after the change every link and anchor tree-wide still resolves.
- Blast radius: the `TESTING.md` move touches `dev/index.md`, `dev/architecture/core-system-design.md`, and one `CLAUDE.md` link line; an executed `INSTALL.md` move touches its three inbound-link files.
